combo_label: Rivers & Lakes × Horses & Riding × The Titanic

entries.clue: Windless, glassy sea that night: not a ripple broke at the foot of the ice
Hair along the top of the neck, plaited into bobbles before a show
White hairs peppered through a dark base — strawberry, if the base is chestnut
Black fuel in her bunkers, one of them with a fire smouldering in it as she sailed
Cunard ship that drove hard through the ice fields to reach the boats
Sheer drop where a river leaves the cliff and turns to noise and spray
Lazy loop a river swings through flat country
Ridden ballet of collected paces and figures, each movement marked out of ten
Quilted cover strapped on against a frosty night; indoors, a floor one
Drifting mountain calved off a Greenland glacier, sighted with no time to spare
Blade the boat crews pulled on, many handling one for the first time
Shipyard city where Harland and Wolff built her and slid her into the water
Long low ground between hills, cut out over ages by a river
